sources.label: Gate GUSD minting and redemption guide (accessed 2026-07-22)

reserveReview.rationale: Rechecked 2026-07-22 for Gate.com's GUSD, not Gemini Dollar: Gate describes GUSD as a yield-bearing certificate supported primarily by U.S. Treasury/RWA products and also refers to stablecoin reserves or yield assets and Gate ecosystem revenue. Gate separately accepts USDT, USDC, or USD1 for subscription; those subscription assets are not evidence of reserve weights or continuing holdings. No token-specific composition, named custodian, or current assurance report is published, so the reserve remains one explicit mixed basket rather than an unsupported split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gate GUSD product and minting disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Gate does not publish current weights or instrument identities for Treasury/RWA products, stablecoin reserves or yield assets, ecosystem revenue, or the custody providers supporting the product.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The issuer names broad reserve and yield sources but does not publish a current composition or a defensible split; accepted subscription tokens are not treated as reserve dependencies.

providers.name: Gate ecosystem and undisclosed RWA custodians

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Gate does not identify the legal reserve vehicle, custody providers, provider shares, segregation model, bankruptcy remoteness, or rehypothecation terms for GUSD backing.
